name: Are new construction homes in Miami more expensive than resales?

mainEntity.name: Are new construction homes in Miami more expensive than resales?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, new construction homes in Miami can have a higher initial purchase price compared to similar-sized resale properties due to modern features, new materials, and builder premiums. However, this higher upfront cost can be offset by lower maintenance expenses in the initial years, reduced energy costs due to updated systems, and builder warranties that cover major components. When comparing, factor in potential savings on renovations, repairs, and energy efficiency that an older home might require. Your agent can help you analyze the total cost of ownership.
acceptedAnswer.description: New construction homes in Miami often have a higher initial price, but can offer long-term savings through lower maintenance, reduced energy costs, and builder warranties.
